newsitem.title: USA: Positron's IPO rises slightly on first day.
newsitem.headline: Positron's IPO rises slightly on first day.

text.p: Positron Fiber Systems Corp closed on Monday at $11-1/8 per share, a little higher than its debut price of $11.
The company's initial public offering priced 5.0 million shares at the top of its expected price range of $9 to $11 per share, said underwriter Robertson, Stephens & Co.
The company said in its filing that it will use the proceeds of the estimated $40 million deal for working capital and general coporate purposes, including potential acquisitions.
Positron designs, develops, markets and supports advanced broadband access network systems for local telecommunications carriers.
